Most alternatives are point solutions. One does search, another does browsers, another does scraping. TinyFish is the only platform that integrates search, fetch, browser, and agent into one API key and one Wallet.

Reliability and structure. Our search hits Google's actual live index through a real browser, not a secondary index or cached results. You get typed JSON objects back, not markdown blobs your model has to parse.

C++ patches compiled directly into the Chromium binary — not JS injection. Bot detection services see a real browser because it is one. 85% pass rate across Akamai, Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, and Imperva.

89.9% overall on Mind2Web, the industry-standard benchmark for web agents. 81.9% on hard tasks, where Operator scores 43.2% and Claude scores 32.4%. All 300 runs are open-sourced and independently verifiable.

Yes. Vault integration lets agents log into portals, navigate authenticated dashboards, and extract from gated content without exposing credentials to the LLM.
